title: After a bulk change, failures stay ticked and success leaves bulk mode
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
  3. Seed a few inventory parts (tag throwaway data "ZZAUTOTEST", e.g. part number "ZZAUTOTEST-PKG-1", name "ZZAUTOTEST package part") via New Inventory Part. Turn Deactivate parts on.
custom_steps:
1. Deactivate a selection where all succeed; observe the mode and selection afterwards.
  2. Deactivate a selection where some parts fail; observe the mode and which rows stay selected.
  3. Enter the mode again, then switch between Active and Inactive tabs.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • When every ticked part changes successfully the mode is left and the selection cleared; when some fail the mode stays on and only the failed parts stay selected (so the user can retry).
  • Switching between the Active and Inactive tabs leaves the mode and clears the selection.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 2 (Deactivate parts); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R14: “When every ticked part changes successfully, the mode is left and the selection is cleared.”
  • S2-R15: “When some parts fail, the mode stays on and the selection keeps only the parts that failed.”
  • S2-R16: “Switching between the Active and Inactive tabs leaves the mode and clears the selection.”
